text: Let's limit the implementation detail on this card. We should avoid functions and filenames and speak about concepts - the decision should be independent from the implementation. also, there's "amended" section - let's merge it all so we only show the final decision content

card werk-reflink  [decided]
A #card-id in any text is a link
why: The map is a graph, but a reference written in prose was a dead string. You had to search for the id by hand.

cardLinks() in web/md.js turns #card-id into <a href="#card-id">. The href is the hash route the map already uses, so a click needs no handler.

Only an id the map knows becomes a link. web/app.js passes knows(id), which checks G.byId. A dead reference stays plain text, so a link always lands somewhere.

Where it renders: the card body, the why line, the finding line, the notes thread, your own messages in the pane, and the agent's replies. Not the card summary in a grid tile, because that tile is a button and an anchor inside a button is invalid.

What it leaves alone:
- A code span with more than an id in it. `node src/cli.ts show #rollup` is a command, not a reference.
- A fenced block.
- A heading. `# rollup` needs a space, an id does not have one.
- A URL fragment. The character before the # must not be a word character or a slash.
- A bare single word with no hyphen or colon, hashless. align and loop are ordinary English words as often as they are ids, so only #align links, not align on its own.

Amended 2026-09-09 (#werk-refs, merged here): a bare id still links without the #, as long as it has a hyphen or a colon — al-diff, pr-iface:opt0 — because that shape never occurs in prose. A code span that is nothing but a card id — `al-diff` or `#al-diff` — links too, through the same check, instead of staying a dead <code> span. A command inside a code span still stays code, since the whole span has to be only the id.

md() also stopped running bold and italic inside a code span. Code spans are stashed before the other inline rules and restored last.

                                      a ghost is frozen: no edit, no retitle, no re-add.
                                      To change one, discard it and propose it again.
  werk link <from> <to> --type <t>    t = refines|depends_on|supported_by|alternative_to
       [--why "..."]                  required for depends_on: what <from> takes from <to>.
                                      Linking an existing depends_on again sets its reason.
                                      See #vi-prop-linkwhy
  werk unlink <from> <to> --type <t>
  werk status <id> <status>           decided | open | proto
                                      decided requires, checked against the log, not the prose:
                                        - who is set
                                        - a depends_on edge, or --no-basis (see "werk edit")
                                        - if who:you, an alternative_to option, or --unchallenged
                                        - a kill criterion on record (see "werk kill")
                                      each missing fact fails with the command that fixes it
  werk kill <id> --form metric|manual|no-metric|revisit   record when to revisit a decision.
                                      See #kill. One call adds one criterion.
